part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `formatter<group_digits_view<T>>::format` (include/fmt/format.h:4196), which cast the value directly to an unsigned type, so negatives became huge two's-complement values without a sign.

The fix uses `detail::make_write_int_arg(t.value, sign_t::none)` to compute the absolute value and the `-` prefix before calling `write_grouped`, the same mechanism the regular integer formatter uses. All 123 format tests and the full ctest suite (20/20) pass, including the previously failing negative-value cases like `fmt::group_digits(-10000000)` → `-10,000,000`.
